persistent_sleep_configuration: Regulator class suspend can update SWEN before UV fails. Settings persist; this is not a generic regulator-core rollback defect. A failed device callback does not mark is_suspended, so its normal resume is skipped. No PM/core edit is made.
independent_ownership: normal+AO aggregate ACTIVE; normal+SO aggregate SLEEP. Separate boot holds hand off on corresponding acknowledged enabled votes. SO release rearms the covering SLEEP hold, including uncertain failures and subsequent normal requests.
CPR: Optional vdd-mx-sleep retains 1337500 uV after calibration/clock checks. Managed disable precedes put and retries once; two failures are explicitly fatal. Old DTs preserve behavior.
full_entry_still_open: Global preparation and abort/restore must own any lower SLEEP request after verified CPU/APC state and CPR feedback/IRQ quiescence.
SMD synchronous replies need IRQs: prepare_late precedes noirq. A prepare_late failure skips platform resume_early and needs inline rollback.
L2 SPM currently only arbitrates voltage. Sequencer RAM, cache handoff, SCM L2_OFF and abort disarm are absent.
RPM freeze/drain, context handoff and MPM wake topology remain incomplete. No physical SLEEP entry is authorized.
vendor_reference: src/vendor-linux/arch/arm/boot/dts/msm8226-regulator.dtsi defines separate l3 AO and SO voters. src/vendor-linux/arch/arm/boot/dts/msm8226-v2-pm.dtsi and arch/arm/mach-msm/msm-pm.c describe the unported system entry topology.
MAINTAINERS_coverage: Existing drivers/pmdomain/qcom/cpr*.h covers cpr-sleep.h; raw FILE_PATH_CHANGES advisory retained without suppression.
